required_tests: Read-only reconciliation must join decisions, simulations, broadcasts, receipts, balance deltas, and exits.

summary: Only GPT supplied a valid report; Gemini and Copilot supplied no valid opinions. The architecture-only evidence is stale and lacks runtime forensics. All proposals are therefore deferred pending independent support and fresh measured evidence. No implementation, live change, or deployment is authorized.
